_comment: v0.16 F1 (#308) TALK route of 'The Price Kept': Krshia's stall brokers a quiet run south (the 8-gold alternate, so the free [Charming Smile] arm renders visible-locked beside it), banking camp_trade_brokered; then the report to Rags on the southern rise closes the quest. NO options-array pin anywhere in this script by design -- four region lanes append rows to Krshia's hub and to Rags's, and a pinned list reds every one of them at the merge train; the cursor indices below are derived from a REAL run's events.jsonl (the visible list, never the authored order). Route purity is proved by payload-filtered absent-asserts on the other two route counters. No combat: the fixture's rng_state is inert here.

steps._comment: Bump north into Krshia's cell (13,2): a blocked move sets facing without moving, the walkthroughs' own robust-facing idiom (player_facing is never trusted).
First talk this waking plays her rotating pool line; the second interact opens the crate graph (crate_talk's documented two-step).

VISIBLE list at this fixture: 1 'I'll look into it.', 2 'What's on the stall today?', 3 'Just visiting.', 4 'I've a few things I don't need. Buying?', 5 the [Charming Smile] quiet-run row (visible-LOCKED, no skill), 6 the 8-gold alternate. Every crate/wrong-order row is progress-gated and hidden.

payload_contains.speaker: Krshia
payload_contains.text: Hrr. South. Grain, salt, hide-thread, and a cart that does not stop where anyone is counting. You will not say whose hands take it, and I will not ask, yes? I will price it as wool.

steps._comment: The exact ledger: 12 -> 4. Paying is not persuading -- the gold arm banks no persuaded_someone of its own, so the 4 asserted at the end is the quest grant alone.
Cross-map hop the route does not need to re-prove; lands one cell north of the shipped approach cell so the last step south is walked for real (rags_meeting_loop's own idiom).

payload_contains.speaker: Rags
payload_contains.text: Good trade. Plains quiet. Go safe.

steps._comment: Settled hub, VISIBLE list: 1 '(Leave them to their business.)', 2 the F1 offer. Every earlier row is hidden by met_rags / rags_price_named / rags_meeting_settled.

payload_contains.speaker: Rags
payload_contains.text: Carts came. Gnoll kept quiet. Good.

steps._comment: winter VISIBLE list on the TALK route: 1 'How do I help?', 2 the trade rung, 3 '(Leave her to it.)'. The larder and ground rungs are progress-gated on counters this route never banks.

payload_contains.speaker: Rags
payload_contains.text: Price kept. Goblins remember. Longer than Humans.

steps._comment: ROUTE PURITY, payload-filtered (a bare-type absent-assert on accomplishment_recorded would scan the run's own banks and red).
The brokered path's own grant: persuaded_someone 4 (quest resolution) + 0 from the gold arm.
